analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the past 2 sessions. RSI at 57.4 remains in neutral territory, while the MACD histogram has worsened from 0.3164 to -0.1832, continuing weak convergence. Volume is also subdued at 0.64x the 5-day average, indicating a lack of directional conviction. At 94.8% of its 52-week high, upside potential appears limited. Both buy and sell scores are low, warranting a continued neutral stance.
